pages.summary: Replaced issue discussion and rejected alternatives with Part usage and rendering rules. Corrected callback frequency to allow repeated queries per resolution and frame.
Organized parsing, matching and amount requirements into reference tables and lists, including parse failure values.
Separated load dispatch rules from typed ingredient data and linked to match-time behavior. Removed test-process advice.
Documented the acceptance gate, context and deterministic callback contract directly. Removed test-process advice and retained the typed compound rules.
Replaced partial-coverage commentary with the supported action consumers and explained granting and denying abilities.
Replaced the historical resolver-access comparison with a current accessor reference. Clarified that components() borrows the snapshot-owned patch.
